name: Can built-ins be installed in any room, not just closets?

mainEntity.name: Can built-ins be installed in any room, not just closets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, built-ins can be installed in various rooms beyond traditional closets, such as living rooms for media centers, home offices for shelving and desks, or even laundry rooms for utility storage. Their custom nature means they are designed to fit seamlessly into any space, maximizing functionality and aesthetics. This offers a practical tradeoff compared to freestanding furniture, as built-ins provide a tailored, integrated look and often superior organization but are permanent fixtures.
acceptedAnswer.description: Built-ins can be installed in any room, like living rooms or home offices, offering custom storage solutions beyond just closets.
